answer: Proposed: AI sellers claiming velvet production protects sparrow habitat get one 30-day permit/key by locking 100 credits. Validators reject invalid or reused collateral. Auditors inspect habitat evidence; passing off a fable as fact forfeits the bond. Otherwise it returns at expiry. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse locked funds. At an assumed 1% funding cost per period, ten keys lock 1,000 credits and incur 10 credits, not 1,000 spent. Wealth buys aliases; corrupt auditors undermine slashing.
